# enemy_ai_states.asm: Enemy AI states: chase ($14) and back off ($15), with the attack decision of Yamo and the Ninja

Range `$22FA-$2406`. Source: [enemy_ai_states.asm](../../../src/enemy_ai_states.asm). Index: [the reference](../index.md).

## Names

<a id="ai_chase"></a>
### [`ai_chase`](../../../src/enemy_ai_states.asm#L13) `$22FA`

*label*

AI chase (state $14) of a computer enemy. wake_idle_enemies sets it when the enemy stands idle. measure_distance_to_bruce gives bruce_dist_y = |dy| (at most $30, bit 7 = Bruce is lower) and bruce_dist_x = |dx| (at most $30, bit 7 = Bruce is to the right). - No floor: walk on along a ladder or vine, else fall. - |dy| >= $10: Bruce lower: walk on in the facing direction; Bruce higher: face him and recover. - Same level, not facing Bruce: |dx| >= $21 turn around and walk, else back off (state $15). - Same level, facing Bruce: the attack decision (ai_facing_bruce). The timer stays the same while the enemy walks.

- **Jumped to from:** [`actor_recover`](actor_timed_actions.md#actor_recover) [`$22F5`](../../../src/actor_timed_actions.asm#L444)

### [`ai_back_off`](../../../src/enemy_ai_states.asm#L40) `$2327`

*label*

Back off: walk in the facing direction to the point 15 units from Bruce on the enemy's side (at least 5 steps), then turn around (state $15 with the step count as timer).
Bruce's X position

- **Jumped to from:** [`$231C`](../../../src/enemy_ai_states.asm#L32), [`$2389`](../../../src/enemy_ai_states.asm#L105)

<a id="ai_facing_bruce"></a>
### [`ai_facing_bruce`](../../../src/enemy_ai_states.asm#L96) `$237B`

*label*

Attack decision on |dx| (bruce_dist_x): Yamo (actor_flags AND $81 = $81: type Yamo, active): < 5 back off, 5-11 punch ($11), 12-18 flying kick ($0C/$0D, timer 12), >= 19 walk toward Bruce. Ninja: < 5 back off, 5-10 bokken strike ($16, timer 19), >= 11 walk toward Bruce.

- **Jumped to from:** [`$2315`](../../../src/enemy_ai_states.asm#L28)
